client_updates.highlight: Lighthouse: Gloas partial data columns support deployed to PeerDAS devnet-7
Prysm: Gloas support implemented + internal review done; revamping peer scoring for observability
Geth: sparse blob pool merged; bug fixed in Kurtosis cross-client testing with Nethermind
Geth: peer quality protection (builder/pool metrics) merged; V5-only migration Kurtosis testing complete — V4 shutdown feasible
Nethermind: V4+V5 dual activation planned for mainnet; topic-based discovery + bot-node test harness in progress

topic_streams_extension.highlight: GossipSub topic streams extension (spec PR #729): each topic gets a long-lived stream; topic name sent once as header, eliminating per-message overhead
Solves head-of-line blocking across topics; works with yamux/MPLEX interleaving and QUIC; backwards-compatible extension
Go implementation complete with Shadow interop test; seeking second implementation for interop validation

networking_simulator.highlight: JVM QUIC-based simulator (Anton/Consensys): mainnet-scale gossip simulation — 8,000 nodes, 16,000 messages in ~20 min, ~500 GB RAM
Validated against Shadow with ~1% cumulative error; parallelized via per-component local simulated time
Currently non-deterministic due to Quiche TLS internals; pure-JVM QUIC impl considered for future determinism

chainscope.highlight: Chainscope: continuous Ethereum network scanner — 120+ chains, 80K reachable nodes, client distribution, latency, bandwidth, churn, protocol version matrices
Chainscope shows partial messages extension adoption level on mainnet; execution payload envelope protocol already visible
Chainscope public URL coming soon; ping Csaba for early access

attestation_bundling.highlight: EIP PR #11905: attestation bundling via partial messages — deduplicates attestation data, ~45-50% bandwidth saving, bundles up to ~10 attestations; no fork required, independently deployable
Daniel (Lighthouse): tree-structured in-network aggregation explored — ~70% bandwidth saving in simulation; compatible with bundling EIP
Raul's EIP-8243 (pre-aggregated attestations at source) discussed as complementary; SEAL mechanism enables privacy-preserving validator channeling

action_items.action: Implement topic streams extension (spec PR #729) for interop testing against Go reference impl
Collaborate on attestation bundling EIP (PR #11905) to incorporate in-network aggregation and batching-at-source compatibility

decisions.decision: Geth V4 discovery shutdown considered viable pending broader client V5 migration confirmation
